environment.description: Same Go binary deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB has a listener rule on the target group that adds a fixed response header via an AWS Lambda@Edge-equivalent mechanism (ALB action: fixed-response is NOT used; instead the response passes through an ALB response header insertion). However, the actual CSP enforcement comes from an Envoy sidecar proxy (v1.28) injected by AWS App Mesh with a Lua filter on the egress listener that appends 'Content-Security-Policy: default-src \'self\'; script-src \'self\'; object-src \'none\'' to ALL responses with Content-Type containing 'text/html'. The Envoy filter is configured via a VirtualNode listener policy and applies unconditionally regardless of upstream response headers. Note: the Envoy sidecar operates at the network namespace level (iptables REDIRECT rules capture all outbound traffic on port 8080 before it reaches the ALB), meaning the header is injected before the response ever leaves the task's network interface.

config.infrastructure: ECS Fargate, App Mesh with Envoy 1.28 sidecar
config.network: private subnet, ALB in public subnet
config.envoy_lua_filter:
function envoy_on_response(response_handle)
  local ct = response_handle:headers():get('content-type')
  if ct and string.find(ct, 'text/html') then
    response_handle:headers():add('content-security-policy', "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'")
  end
end
config.app_mesh_virtual_node: listener policy applies Lua filter to egress on port 8080
config.csp_enforcement: browser-enforced via injected CSP header on all text/html responses
